title: Motivation to learn and teach home economics in higher education: Predictors and comparative analysis

primary.rationale: Deterministic query-to-theme assignment for owner calibration; not an AI judgement.

short_summary: Motivation, influenced by key personal and professional factors, plays a crucial role in the performance of both students and teachers. This study examined the motivational factors of higher education students and teachers in learning and teaching Home Economics (HE) in a state university. A total of 344 participants—294 students and 50 teachers—were surveyed using researcher-developed and adapted instruments. Data were analyzed using descriptive and inferential statistics at a 95% confidence level. HE students reported an overall motivation mean of 3.46, interpreted as “frequently motivated.”
